           trim(substr(artist, 1, instr(artist || ',', ',') - 1)) AS artist,
           ltrim(substr(artist, instr(artist || ',', ',') + 1)) AS rest
    FROM cards
    WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL

    FROM split

                a2.artist AS artist2

ORDER BY artist1, artist2;
